events.title: Demo Patch #2: Leaving Breadcrumbs
events.summary: Leaving breadcrumbsThe game is full of bugs, but they shouldn't be the ones you can't fight. This update adds a breadcrumbs system: in the parts of the game where most issues were reported, the game now remembers the last things that happened before an error. When you send a bug report from the in-game reporter, those breadcrumbs go with it, which gives me a much better chance of finding and fixing what went wrong.
